cases.assertion: valid session and canonical safe ID are required
missing or deleted comments, inactive authors and either direction of a comment-author block are excluded at preflight, write and count
like and unlike are idempotent while write-time visibility is enforced
first like alone notifies a still-visible author with proper metadata and preferences
committed like and later notification failure have explicit partial-success behavior
both clients serialize a comment's reactions and display the confirmed server count in regular and cited views, with actual Oracle and Redis acceptance tracked separately
